sources.title: Multi-functional Power Meter DPM-C520 User Manual
sources.note: Delta manual as mirrored by the Brazilian distributor Dicomp; section 7.1 Overview of Parameters and 9.3 MODBUS Communication. Delta current download-center copy was not reachable without accepting its terms-of-use page

notes: Modbus RTU slave on RS-485. The manual gives baud rates 9600, 19200 and 38400, 8 data bits, parity none/even/odd, 1 stop bit, and a device address of 1 to 255 with a factory default of 1 (broadcast 255 is mentioned); the factory baud rate is not stated.

Function 03 reads, 06 and 16 (0x10) write; at most 50 registers per read and 48 per multiple write. Addresses are the hexadecimal addresses of the manual's table 7.1 (0x100 is the first meter value, shown as 40257 in Modicon format), address base 0.

32-bit values (float32 for measurements, uint32 for the energies) use two registers. The manual's figure for the IEEE 754 packet lists the low word before the high word, so the word order is taken as low word first; the byte order inside a word is big endian. This is read from a diagram and should be confirmed on a device.

The manual's parameter table has gaps (for example the alarm blocks between 0x25 and 0x33 and the harmonic registers between 0x168 and 0x173 are not printed); only registers that are printed are mapped.
Date and time are packed two bytes per register (year and month, day and week, hour and minute) with the second or day in the next register; the manual does not say which byte is which.
The registers 0x600 to 0x609 return the values selected in the parameter grouping registers (0x50C to 0x515); their type depends on the selected value, so they are not mapped.
The manual's preface names the DPM-C530A while its title and tables are for the DPM-C520 (model code 2); the tables are taken as the DPM-C520's.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
description: Delta DPM-C520 multifunction power meter: voltages, currents, powers, energies, THD, maximum and minimum values with time stamps, alarms and settings
